effects.description: Dominic conjures three magical boxes around the target, each delivering heavy punches that deal Attack * 280% Area Damage and stun the target for 1 second.
Dominic hurls roses that transform into flames, dealing Attack * 140% damage and setting the target on fire which deals Attack * 12% damage every 0.5 seconds for 2 seconds.
Dominic uses illusions to escape. When Health drops to zero, Dominic vanishes and reappears in a magical box 5 seconds later with 50% Health. This skill can be used once per battle.
Dominic equips the troops with weapons cleverly crafted from magic props, increasing damage dealt by 20% for all troops.

2.trigger-point: Increase Lancer Damage + Poison Damage Taken

effects.description: Dominic equips the Lancer of Dominic with secret devices that launch poisonous spikes, increasing their damage dealt per attack by 60%. Poisoned targets take 25% more damage for 1 turn.

3.trigger-point: Reduce Damage Taken + Increase Damage Dealt

effects.description: Dominic disrupts enemy strategies by performing optical tricks with a mirror, reducing damage taken by Infantry and Marksman by 15% and increasing their damage dealt by 15%.

exploration.ability: Dominic perfects magical skills through dedicated practice, increasing damage dealt by {v1}.
exploration.name: Illusion Mastery

expedition.ability: Dominic turns the battlefield into a stage, increasing the Lethality of rallied Troop by {v1}.
expedition.name: Grand Fantasy
